_comment: Measured wall clock in seconds per test executable, used by tools/ci-test-shard.js to balance the CI shard matrix. per_push = the per-push filter (~[performance]~[perf]~[benchmark]~[!benchmark]~[long]); long = the [long]~[vorago-sweep] lane. Refresh from a Catch2 run with -d yes (or the summary of tools/run-close-lanes.js) whenever a suite grows; a stale entry only unbalances the shards, it never fails a run. Source: 2026-10-09, 15 suites run concurrently on a 32-core box (F:/tmp/p13d/ci_suites/summary.txt) and the Phase 13d close lanes.
